p3_01_persistence.backend: python stdlib sqlite3 (no SQLAlchemy, no new third-party dependency)
p3_01_persistence.append_only_enforcement: SQL BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE triggers raising ABORT; verified at construction time by a transactional probe that fails fast if a SQLite build ignores triggers
p3_01_persistence.tenant_isolation: tenant_id is part of every primary key and every WHERE clause; empty tenant raises TenantIsolationError
p3_01_persistence.sql_safety: all statements parameterized; identifier helper rejects anything outside ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$; injection payloads verified inert
p3_01_persistence.pagination: opaque integer-offset cursors, malformed cursor raises PersistenceError
p3_01_persistence.sqlalchemy_adapter: not implemented - documented as a host-side contract only

p3_02_api_surface.framework: transport-agnostic dispatcher; FastAPI referenced only inside a guarded import in build_fastapi_router
p3_02_api_surface.mount_status_requires: explicit mark_mounted(mounted_by=...) call with a non-blank host identity
p3_02_api_surface.authorization: declares required scope per route; 401 when scope missing; never derives tenant from request data
p3_02_api_surface.error_mapping: 401 unauthorized / 403 tenant_resolution_required / 404 not_found / 404 route_not_found / 422 validation_error with field / 400 persistence_error / 500 internal_error without leaking detail

p3_03_collection_workers.execution_model: synchronous, caller-invoked run_pending; no thread, process, asyncio loop or scheduler is started
p3_03_collection_workers.retries: bounded exponential backoff with jitter; max_attempts default 5, capped 1..100; delay capped at max_delay_seconds
p3_03_collection_workers.leases: lease_seconds default 300; expired leases reclaimed; LeaseConflictError on concurrent claim by another owner
p3_03_collection_workers.circuit_breaker: per-source closed/open/half_open with failure_threshold, cooldown_seconds and bounded half-open probes
p3_03_collection_workers.idempotency: per-(tenant, idempotency_key) index suppresses duplicates and counts them; stable SHA-256 derived key insensitive to payload key order
p3_03_collection_workers.observability: WorkerMetrics counters (global and per source) plus a bounded structured JobEvent log
p3_03_collection_workers.error_detail_handling: exception text truncated to 500 chars and newlines stripped before storage

source_reliability.reliability_scoring: success ratio over a bounded sliding window (default 50) blended with a 0.5 failure-streak penalty
source_reliability.unscored_sources: score is None and tier is UNSCORED - never a fabricated default; confidence_adjustment returns applied=false
source_reliability.freshness_reference: last successful collection, not last attempt; future-dated timestamps classify as unknown not fresh
source_reliability.verification_promotion: evidence-gated; one rank at a time; requires specific observation_ref and attributable performed_by; placeholder values rejected
source_reliability.verification_demotion: always allowed without evidence (conservative direction); evidence history retained
source_reliability.hard_invariant: no code path sets live_verified from a flag alone
